steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: "New personnel data entry in progress... Facial recognition for Stargazer successful... Welcome aboard the V-710."
As you step into the cockpit, your three companions look towards you in unison... and gawk at Stargazer behind you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When I was trapped in the Tide of Ashes, Stargazer saved me and brought me to the shelter.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She excels at dealing with various crises in WhiteSands, so I invited her to be our special advisor. If we run into trouble, she'll help us.
You do not forget the existence of the Outland Affairs Bureau, and deliberately omit Stargazer's Sinner identity in your introduction to avoid unnecessary repercussions.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: You mean not only did she go inside the Tide of Ashes all by herself, she also got you out, too?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: That's incredible! It's almost impossible to tell where you're going inside the Tide of Ashes... how did you do it? Oh yeah! Did you see an Apostle of Ashes? If you saw one, can you tell me about... mmm—!
A long, slender finger presses against Kawa-kawa's lips.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Shhh... you ask so many questions. Where shall I start?
Kawa-kawa's face blushes bright red. He hurriedly takes a few steps back, looking embarrassed.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft! Look at how bashful Kawa-kawa has become! He's even at a loss for words!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: ...I'm not!
You can't help but smile as you watch Hella tease Kawa-kawa.
But Stargazer does not partake in the scene. Her distant and detached disposition reminds you that even though you have revealed your true identity, there is still a barrier between you two.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Your name is Kawa-kawa, right? It's true that it's impossible to pinpoint directions in the Tide of Ashes. However, there are countless air currents, and one can leave by simply following the direction of the currents.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: But there's a lot of turbulence in the Tide of Ashes. Even if you follow the currents, there's a high chance of getting caught in the turbulence.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Once caught in the turbulence, it is theoretically impossible to get out alive...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Yes. This relies on the experience of the pilot.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: However, there is another foolproof way, and that is to use an Ash Crystal.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It can drive away sandworms and pierce through ashes, for it is a creation born from the Tide of Ashes, and the infallible treasure of the desert bandits.
Kawa-kawa looks down and ponders for a moment before showing an epiphany.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I understand now!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: No wonder the people of DisCity tell me that they cannot explore other routes. Because DisCity's Ash Crystal died.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Once an Ash Crystal dies, it becomes useless. You cannot use it to deal with the desert bandits.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Unless... you find a way to reactivate it.
Stargazer's words plunged the room into silence. The power of the Ash Crystal is related to Mania, and your shackles also seem to be able to affect the sandworms.
...That's certainly a possibility. There may be a chance to reactivate a dead Ash Crystal.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I give you our dead Ash Crystal, would you be able to find a way to reactivate it?
For the first time, you see Stargazer fall into silence. Everyone else looks doubtful.
But out of trust and respect for you, no one questions your suggestion, except...

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: I cannot believe what I just heard. You want to give the Ash Crystal to some unknown woman?

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: I will never allow this under my watch!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: At first, I turned a blind eye to the fact that you invited someone who is not part of the mission to participate without permission.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Now it seems that the Outland Affairs Bureau will have to reassess the security clearance of this individual.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: V-710, I order you to immediately re—
The Outland Affairs Bureau's comms abruptly cuts off. The screen flashes the words "abnormal disruption."

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: "Warning! Warning! The V-710 is under attack by an unidentified source. Temporary defense mode has been activated. Hypercube force field is in effect."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's happening?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The desert bandits haven't given up... They seem to have used the Ash Crystal to command the sandworms to attack the shelter again.
